description:
WETHUnwrapper.unwrap(IWETH9) (src/defi/WETHUnwrapper.sol#24-28) sends eth to arbitrary user
	Dangerous calls:
	- (ok,None) = msg.sender.call{value: address(this).balance}() (src/defi/WETHUnwrapper.sol#26)
reason: False positive: WETHUnwrapper is stateless and permissionless by design; it returns its own unwrapped WETH balance to msg.sender in the same call, and callers transfer-then-unwrap atomically. Triaged here, not with a comment, because LidoAdapterLib CREATE2-deploys it from its creation code, so a source comment would move every diamond's unwrapper address.

description:
Base64.encode(bytes,bool,bool) (src/utils/libraries/Base64.sol#18-78) has bitwise-xor operator ^ instead of the exponentiation operator **: 
	 - mstore(uint256,uint256)(0x3f,ghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_ ^ ! fileSafe * 0x0670) (src/utils/libraries/Base64.sol#41)
reason: False positive: vendored Solady Base64. `xor(..., mul(iszero(fileSafe), 0x0670))` switches the alphabet between URL-safe and standard; XOR is intended. Triaged here, not with a comment, because the file is fmt-ignored and kept byte-exact with upstream.
